title: Swedish security service calls him in over the Som find

tellings.quote: were home they I got the call from the Swedish let's say it's like FBI in Sweden

plain: In 2015, after a Swedish treasure-hunting diver named Dennis Asberg found an object on the seafloor that he likens to a UFO, Sweden's security service called him in. Asberg tells Jesse Michels he got the call once he was home, from what he describes as Sweden's version of the FBI, the US federal police. It suggests the authorities took his find seriously.
